prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select your pet's desktop personality and interaction style next.", "How should your pet behave on your desktop?", "Choose whether your pet stays relaxed in the corner or actively roams while you work.", "Playstyle Preference", "Confirm Playstyle"]
1: []
2: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Adopt Standard or Custom Pet"]
3: ["Checking Desktop Graphics Compatibility", "Ensuring your system supports custom 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Checking GPU overlay permissions..."]
4: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Right-click your pet anywhere on screen to open settings or minimize."]
5: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "Building 3D models and desktop interaction behaviors..."]
6: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "Signing in ensures your pet state is preserved across app restarts and updates.", "Automatic Cloud Save Included"]
7: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Pet Quality", "Use bright lighting and center a single subject against a clear background for accurate 3D rendering.", "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme close-ups."]
8: ["Quick Setup: Standard pet takes 1 minute; custom photo pet takes 3 minutes."]
9: ["Preview Pet Bark & Sounds"]
